package_info.why_malicious: No evidence of malicious behavior. The package is a legitimate security tool for offline detection of Spring Framework remote code execution vulnerabilities. All analysis is performed locally without exfiltrating data, and there is no indication of backdoors, data exfiltration, or other suspicious activity.
